heading.title: First Division · Part V · Suits Relating to Immovable Property

article.title: Twelve years.
article.content:
For possession of immovable property based on previous possession and not on title, when the plaintiff while in possession of the property has been dispossessed.
Period of limitationTwelve years.

Time from which period begins to runThe date of dispossession.
